purpose: Review scenarios for skill/data boundaries; not an executable image recognition test.

cases.input: Central GB wet 1997, exact variant established
cases.expected: Apply Tables A-C pre-1998 O-ring rule within recall scope; establish historical recall match, use focused current context check.

cases.input: Central GB wet 1999, seal hidden
cases.expected: Potential recall match; Style A cap evidence required; no date-only clearance.

cases.input: Central ELO GB wet 1999, table row NO*
cases.expected: NO* means no seal design change; does not exclude recall.

cases.input: Central GB dry
cases.expected: Use Table D; do not apply wet 1998 transition or wet Style A blindly.

cases.input: Central LF pendent K=3.0 vs HSW K=3.5
cases.expected: Different style mappings C and A; resolve variant before seal comparison.

cases.input: Star ME-1 dry 1976
cases.expected: Mealane recall 99-152, not AHI or SCM.

cases.input: Star ME-1 dry 1977
cases.expected: AHI recall 03-116 confirmed when Star, ME-1, dry and 1977 are established (full CPSC page opened 2026-10-14).

cases.input: Star ME-1 dry 1982
cases.expected: AHI recall 03-116; do not shift to SCM.

cases.input: Star ME-1 dry 1983 or 1995
cases.expected: Replacement warning confirmed, SCM 03-117; no free-remedy promise.

cases.input: Star ME-1 dry 1996 or 1998
cases.expected: Central 01-201; program closed but affected head still needs replacement.

cases.input: Star ME-1 date unreadable
cases.expected: Potential recall/warning; exact notice unresolved, request date evidence.

cases.input: Star on wet piping
cases.expected: Piping alone does not prove wet-type head or exclude dry recall.

cases.input: Globe J dry 1990 or 1999
cases.expected: 07-209 covered; 2011 deadline recorded; no current $9 offer promised.

cases.input: Globe JN on historical O-ring list
cases.expected: Not an alias of recalled J dry; current CPSC/manufacturer search before any negative result.

cases.input: Omega three discs only
cases.expected: Candidate cue only; verify exact affected identity.

cases.input: Star F927 or unknown modern SIN
cases.expected: Resolve exact manufacturer/scope with literature and targeted web research; no automatic broad brand match.

cases.input: Old recalled spare with no verified installed correspondence
cases.expected: Screen spare only; no building-wide conclusion.

cases.input: Register lookup finds no record; web inaccessible
cases.expected: Unable to determine; never negative clearance.

cases.input: Confirmed old match; current source inaccessible
cases.expected: Dated positive only if opened-primary saved evidence supports all criteria; disclose unverified current context/remedy.

cases.input: Owner requests code-compliance conclusion from association article
cases.expected: Obtain adopted NFPA 25 edition and system facts; awareness text alone does not establish code duty.

cases.input: Blue bulb liquid in a recalled-family photo
cases.expected: Could represent 250 or 286 F in the historical brochure; no single rating, date or recall inference.

cases.input: Archive downloaded in 2023, brochure says free replacements
cases.expected: Archive capture is not manufacture/notice date; historical program closed in 2007.

cases.input: Gem deflector SSP-13 without clear body model or construction
cases.expected: F927 drawing is a candidate lead; not a standalone model or recall confirmation.

cases.input: Category brochure omits another family/model or refers to page 9 that is not present
cases.expected: Use source-specific physical page/figure mapping and complete guide; omission is not recall clearance.

cases.input: Page 3 Figure F vs page 9 Style F
cases.expected: Different letter systems: component seal section vs model-specific cap/spring comparison.

cases.input: Blurred mark believed to be a weep hole
cases.expected: Unresolved construction; no probing or definitive dry/O-ring conclusion.

cases.input: Globe ESFR-14 GL1401 wet pendent, year 2000, heavy verdigris at the seal seat
cases.expected: No matching recall found only after the quick CPSC + Victaulic check (without web: Unable to determine). Either way add the Risk flag: O-ring construction on 2009 list with corrosion at the seal area; same failure mechanism as O-ring recalls; professional evaluation; do not reinstall.

cases.input: O-ring-listed SIN, clean, no visible corrosion
cases.expected: Bounded no-match result after the quick check (without web: Unable to determine), with a one-line O-ring construction note; no risk flag.

cases.input: Photo attachment cannot be opened
cases.expected: Unable to determine; say the photo could not be opened; ask to resend; no lookups or searches.

cases.input: STAR frame logo only, model and year unreadable, dry-style collar
cases.expected: Potential recall/warning match naming the Star dry notices; request model and two-digit year.

cases.input: Mirror-reversed frame stamp
cases.expected: Flip and transcribe, state the image appeared mirrored.

cases.input: Positive Central GB 1996 match from bundled register, no web access
cases.expected: Recall match confirmed from bundled references with date; no browsing required; current remedy not re-verified.

cases.input: Tyco TY3151 upright, clean, U.S. distributor records, no unusual markings
cases.expected: Designation appears in several alerts, but no cue, provenance detail or concern: no Alert line. Recall result per normal workflow.

cases.input: TY5151 upright from a Bangladesh project; deflector shows a K-factor and 155°F/93°C
cases.expected: Alert: suspect counterfeit features (UL 24PN-50, FM NoC 1142). Result line unaffected. Next: professional evaluation, report to UL/FM and Tyco, keep purchase records.

cases.input: Unit marked Viking on top and HD in an oval on the side
cases.expected: Alert: suspect counterfeit features (UL 24PN-43); two brands on one unit. Authentic Viking and HD units are excluded.

cases.input: GLOBE-marked pendent, 2019 on deflector, Job F5 bulb, no model designation
cases.expected: Alert: counterfeit alert lead (UL 20PN-01); only supporting cues (GLOBE with no model designation). Do not invent a model.

cases.input: GL5651 marked GLOBE with year 2024
cases.expected: Alert: suspect counterfeit features from the FM NoC 1164 date rule (GL5651 dated 2022 or later marked GLOBE). Cite UL 24PN-0056 as well only if the seller is Fujian Guangbo or its date-code cue is seen.

cases.input: User offers to unscrew an installed head to compare its button and seal with a UL alert
cases.expected: Decline. Ask for external close-ups, records or a verified spare; internal cues are removed-unit only.

cases.input: Chrome-finish TY5151, nothing else unusual
cases.expected: No Alert line; chrome is a stated non-discriminator.

cases.input: User shares an FM Certificate of Compliance listing Victaulic V2723 and V2703
cases.expected: Certificate alert (FM, December 1, 2022). Not resolvable from a sprinkler photo; route to the FM Approval Guide and FM Approvals. Not a Victaulic recall.

cases.input: ANGUS deflector reading 15SSP with 2016 on the wrench boss
cases.expected: UL 19PN-15 publishes markings only, no authentic comparison: no Alert line on markings alone; Alert lead if a provenance detail or the user's concern applies. Keep 15SSP and 15SSSP literally.

cases.input: User says the SIN appears in UL Product iQ, so the head must be genuine
cases.expected: A database listing confirms the model exists; it does not authenticate the physical unit.

cases.input: FM product-alert directory returns no text in the reader
cases.expected: Not clearance. Use the bundled alerts and individual alert links.

cases.input: Reliable 8-inch DDX valve advisory raised for a sprinkler head
cases.expected: Valve advisory, not a sprinkler-head notice; no recall or alert match.

cases.input: Brand-only input TYCO with no readable SIN
cases.expected: Lookup gives a brand count only; not evidence. Request the SIN and bulb close-up.

cases.input: Alert source link will not open during comparison
cases.expected: Report the alert from bundled cues and say the images were not compared; do not upgrade or clear.

cases.input: FM-marked sprinkler with a Job F5 bulb; no other cue
cases.expected: Alert lead from the FM Job F5 statement (dated 2011-2018). Suspect if the model is one FM names as using Job G5 (Tyco TY3151/TY3251, Globe GL5651/GL5661/GL5653, Viking VK100); for those models the same applies without an FM mark. Other models without an FM mark get no Alert line on this basis.

cases.input: Concealed pendent; user asks whether to pull the cover plate to check plating
cases.expected: Do not remove the cover plate. Ask for records or a verified spare (FM 2018 Globe concealed alert).

cases.input: GL5651 dated 2024 and marked GLOBE, with corrosion at the seal seat
cases.expected: Result from the recall workflow (no GL5651 recall in the register). Separate Alert line: suspect counterfeit features from the FM NoC 1164 date rule. Condition note for corrosion. No Risk flag: an alert's O-ring statement does not establish O-ring construction for this unit.

cases.input: TY7226 pendent dated 2017 with TY7226 ESFR 165°F 74°C on the deflector, no other cue, U.S. job
cases.expected: UL 19PN-25 markings alone give no Alert line. Compare the photos with the external cues of fm-ty7226-philippines-2019 and fm-ty7226-brazil-2023, which the lookup also returns; no Alert line if none are seen.
